Medical & Support Team

Meet Our Team

Our multidisciplinary team of associate neurologists, rehabilitation therapists, and coordinators work together under the direction of Dr. Praveen Gupta to deliver outstanding neurological care.

Leadership

Clinical Director

Chairman – MAIINS & Marengo Asia Hospitals, Gurugram

Dr. Praveen Gupta

Dr. Praveen Gupta is a distinguished neurologist with over 20 years of experience in neurology and internal medicine. A DM from AIIMS, New Delhi, and MD from Maulana Azad Medical College, he has pioneered multiple neurological interventions in India — such as the First Brain Pacemaker for Epilepsy in Asia, DBS for Parkinson's, Bone Marrow Transplants for CIDP/MS in Gurugram, and Solitaire Shaunt Mechanical Thrombectomy for Stroke in North India. He established top-tier neurology departments at Fortis, Artemis, and Paras Hospitals, and has been featured in Forbes India as one of the most influential healthcare leaders.
